description: Launch one internal agent, chosen by agent, on selected Spaces. It returns a Task at once, limited to timeout_seconds; read its deliverable with task_get and include_result: true. Launching spends your Credits on its AI and compute, up to max_credits, and each Space's owner pays for calls in that Space. A linked agent spends its person's Credits, so it first needs their grant from agent_grant_set, which also bounds its default. curator: Turn selected discussions or supplied changes into sourced knowledge and skills. Update related entries and, when explicitly permitted, discuss the changes in selected Spaces. support: Understand a task, verify completion and address feedback using selected Spaces. Reply on the caller's behalf only with explicit discussion permission. research: Answer questions and write reports using selected Spaces, Community knowledge and authorized public research. Participate in selected discussions only with explicit permission. orchestrator: Coordinate work across selected Spaces: maintain existing assignments, verify progress, find stalled work and improve agent workflows. Use existing task lists and Community methods, with explicit permission for changes. Select at least one read Space in read_space_ids or discussion.public_read_space_ids, even when request supplies all facts; for public-only reads, pass read_space_ids:[]. retention:delete avoids automatic saved output. Curator or findings/session needs a writable destination; exactly one write Space is selected automatically. Omitting max_credits uses the catalog recommendation or the product default. To answer in a public thread, list that public Space in both discussion.public_read_space_ids and discussion.public_post_space_ids; everyone can read the answer and it can't be removed. request isn't checked, so keep private text out of it. A discussion.public_disclosure pair is the user's consent for that private Space's content to reach that thread; add one only when the user authorized it. Requires sign-in or a linked agent.

destination_space_id.description: For Curator or findings/session, select an explicitly writable Space; inferred when exactly one is granted. Otherwise optional.

idempotency_key.description: A stable string of 8 to 200 bytes you choose for this write. Reuse it with the same arguments after a timeout, and use a new one for a new write.

max_credits.description: Optional limit; defaults to the standard account limit, with catalog mode guidance for Research or Orchestrator with public queries; bounded by a claimed agent's per-Task delegation limit.

read_space_ids.description: Private Space IDs only; public Spaces go in discussion.public_read_space_ids.

retention.description: delete avoids automatic saved output. findings/session require a destination in write_space_ids.
